title: 第2298章 魔天幻的神通第2297章 转向进攻三号魔族营地
slug: 无限吞噬你们求我晋级慢一点
content_zh:
天武宗联军于是从三号魔族营地杀向二号魔族营地。
半路上，天武宗联军遇到一些三号魔族营地的残兵，派出一部分兵力前往追杀。
很多魔族被击溃了，在南部区域内四散而逃。
江尘只是派出一小部分的精锐去清除这些残兵。
不让这些魔族残兵继续对南部的生灵造成损失。
天武宗总部这边，收到江尘的命令后，也是派出第二批军队，实力也是相当强大，虽然不如第一批。
收到江尘的命令后，第二批军队主要负责是清除一号与二号魔族营地的残兵，只要遇到魔族，格杀勿论。
至于江尘这边，负责对付南部区域最后一个魔族营地。
魔天幻这边也是收到江尘率领大军朝着二号营地而来。
在这儿等着江尘的大军到达，魔族这边做好战斗的准备了。
半个月后，江尘率领大军来到二号魔族营地附近，此时，江尘的大军周围区域已经出现很多魔族的探子，将江尘的位置实时汇报上去。
“魔族这边，准备得不错，提前布置了这么多禁制，不过，我们的大军，坐在战舰上，不走地面，很多禁制是白白布置了。”江尘淡淡地道。
江尘只需要用神识扫视一下周围的区域，就能发现什么地方有禁制，什么地方有暗中的阵法。
江尘所过之处，命令战舰将那些暗中的禁制或是阵法，全部摧毁，让魔族的精心准备毁于一旦。
这可让魔族们气死了。
此时，魔天幻也是率领魔族的精锐大军前往，与江尘所在的天武宗联军遥遥相对，大战一触即发。
此时，天武宗联军这边也是杀气腾腾，只要江尘一声令下，众人马上发起进攻。
魔天幻走在魔族大军的最前方，一些大乘境的魔族强者跟在魔天幻的身后。
“江尘，你总算来了，等了你许久了。”魔天幻开口道。
“你们魔族的情报做得不错，居然能知晓我的名字。”江尘淡淡地道。

“江尘，你在通幽秘境里了，杀了我们这么多魔族天骄，你在我们界面那儿，早就出名了，我认得你，并不奇怪，这一次，我们魔族大举入侵你们圣域界，杀死你，也是主要目标之一。”魔天幻开口道。
“哦？我在你们魔族这边居然这么有名？真是抬举我了，原来，我先前在通幽秘境杀死的一批魔族天才，原来是你们界面的天才啊，不得不说，你们魔族的天骄，实力真的不咋的，没有这么大的本事，却到处去惹事，被灭了，也是活该，你说对吧？”江尘淡笑道。
江尘的话，差点让周围的魔族气死。
江尘的话太损了。
居然这么侮辱他们魔族。
“江尘，你这是找死。”魔天幻大怒。
“哼，找死的是你们，你们数个界面联合入侵我们圣域界，对我们界面的生灵烧杀抢掠，只要进入我们界面的敌人，我们都不会放过，先前我们摧毁了两个你们魔族的营地，就是你们的下场。”江尘冷冷地道。
魔天幻率先出手杀向江尘，他要试试江尘的实力。
虽然传闻江尘很强。
但是没有试过的话，又怎么知道呢？
现在江尘已经是大乘境六重了，自然不会忌惮一个大乘境九重的魔族，即使这个魔天幻在同阶中难觅敌手，但是终究不如不如江尘这么妖孽。
魔天幻手中的短剑，一道黑光杀向江尘，速度极快。
江尘只是一拳轰出。
魔天幻的那道黑光直接被击溃，完全抵挡不住江尘的拳影。
content_en:
The Tianwuzong allied forces then fought from the No. 3 Demon Clan Camp to the No. 2 Demon Clan Camp.
On the way, the Tianwuzong allied forces encountered some remnants of the No. 3 Demon Tribe camp and sent part of their troops to chase them.
Many demons were defeated and fled in all directions in the southern area.
Jiang Chen only sent a small group of elites to eliminate these remaining soldiers.
Don't let these demonic remnants continue to cause losses to the creatures in the south.
At the Tianwuzong headquarters, after receiving Jiang Chen's order, they also dispatched a second batch of troops. Their strength was also quite strong, although not as good as the first batch.
After receiving Jiang Chen's order, the second batch of troops was mainly responsible for clearing out the remnants of the No. 1 and No. 2 demon camps. As long as they encountered demons, they would kill them without mercy.
As for Jiang Chen, he is responsible for dealing with the last demon camp in the southern region.
Mo Tianhuan also received Jiang Chen leading an army towards Camp No. 2.
Waiting here for Jiang Chen's army to arrive, the demons are ready to fight.
Half a month later, Jiang Chen led his army to the vicinity of Demon Clan Camp No. 2. At this time, many demon spies had appeared in the area around Jiang Chen's army, reporting Jiang Chen's location in real time.
"The demons are well prepared and have arranged so many restrictions in advance. However, our army is sitting on the battleship and not walking on the ground. Many restrictions have been placed in vain." Jiang Chen said calmly.
Jiang Chen only needs to scan the surrounding area with his spiritual consciousness to find where there are restrictions and where there are secret formations.
Wherever Jiang Chen passed, he ordered the warships to destroy all the secret restrictions or formations, ruining the demon clan's careful preparations.
This makes the demons furious.
At this time, Mo Tianhuan also led the elite army of the demon clan to go, facing Jiang Chen's Tianwuzong coalition forces from a distance, and the war was about to break out.
At this time, the Tianwuzong coalition forces were also murderous. As long as Jiang Chen gave the order, everyone would immediately launch an attack.
Mo Tianhuan walked at the forefront of the demon army, and some powerful demons in the Mahayana realm followed behind Mo Tianhuan.
"Jiang Chen, you are finally here. I have been waiting for you for a long time." Mo Tianhuan said.
"You demon tribe has done a good job in intelligence, and you actually know my name." Jiang Chen said calmly.
"Jiang Chen, you are in the Tongyou Secret Realm. You have killed so many of our demon geniuses. You have long been famous in our interface. I recognize you. It is not surprising. This time, our demons invaded your holy realm in a big way. Killing you is also one of the main goals." Mo Tianhuan said.
"Oh? I'm so famous among you Demon Clan? It's really a compliment to me. It turns out that the group of Demon Clan geniuses I killed in the Tongyou Secret Realm turned out to be the geniuses of your interface. I have to say that the prodigies of your Demon Clan are really not that good. They don't have such great abilities, but they go around causing trouble and deserve to be killed. Don't you think so?" Jiang Chen said with a smile.
Jiang Chen's words almost made the surrounding demons angry to death.
Jiang Chen's words were too damaging.
To actually insult their demon clan like this.
"Jiang Chen, you are seeking death." Mo Tianhuan was furious.
"Hmph, it's you who are looking for death. Several of your interfaces jointly invaded our sanctuary world, burning, killing and looting the creatures in our interfaces. As long as the enemies enter our interfaces, we will not let them go. We destroyed two of your demon clan's camps before, and this is your fate." Jiang Chen said coldly.
Mo Tianhuan was the first to attack Jiang Chen. He wanted to test Jiang Chen's strength.
Although it is said that Jiang Chen is very strong.
But how would you know if you haven't tried it?
Now that Jiang Chen is already at the sixth level of the Mahayana realm, he will naturally not be afraid of a demon who is at the ninth level of the Mahayana realm. Even though it is difficult for this demon to find an opponent at the same level, it is still not as evil as Jiang Chen.
The dagger in Mo Tianhuan's hand shot towards Jiang Chen with a black light at an extremely fast speed.
Jiang Chen just punched out.
Mo Tianhuan's black light was directly hitIt collapsed and was completely unable to withstand Jiang Chen's fist.
